caption: The video captures a top-down view of an orange slice floating in juice, surrounded by a crown-shaped splash rim with thin spikes and scattered droplets. Throughout the clip, the sharp outward spikes progressively shorten and blunt, showing the crown subsiding rather than growing. The rim becomes thicker and more continuous, smoothing its spiky silhouette into a rounded wall around the slice. Small droplets on the left and right periphery gradually diminish or merge back toward the rim as the surface settles. A bright highlight on the right side of the crown shifts and intensifies, consistent with changing surface reflection and ripples. The orange slice remains near center with its segment pattern fixed, showing slight drift while the central well appears deeper.
